label: John Smith Email
subject: Catching up + that hiking trip we keep putting off
body:
Hey Mike,

Man, it's been way too long. I think the last time we actually talked was at Kevin's barbecue back in February, and I keep meaning to call you but life has just been a blur lately. Work has been nuts — we wrapped up the Hartwell project last week (finally), and I was so fried by Friday that I basically slept through all of Saturday. Becky thought I was sick.

Anyway, I was looking at the calendar and realized summer is going to sneak up on us again if we don't actually plan something. Are you still down for that backpacking trip in the Sierras? I was thinking maybe the loop around Desolation Wilderness or, if we want to go bigger, three or four days on the Rae Lakes Loop. I know you mentioned wanting to do something more challenging this year, and Rae Lakes would definitely deliver on that front (people say the climb up Glen Pass is brutal but worth it).

A few logistics if we want to make this real:

- Last weekend of July or first weekend of August seems to work best for me. Becky has her sister's wedding mid-July so that's out.
- Permits for Rae Lakes are competitive — if we go that route we'd need to apply through recreation.gov pretty soon.
- I picked up a new tent over the winter (the Big Agnes Copper Spur — way lighter than my old one) so we can split gear differently this time. I can carry the tent, you handle the stove?

Also, side note: how's your dad doing? You mentioned he was having some health stuff going on last time we talked. Hope things have settled down on that front.

Let me know what you're thinking. Even if the big trip doesn't pan out, we should at least grab a beer soon. The new place over on Lakeshore (Hopfields, I think?) is supposed to be solid.

Talk soon,
John

P.S. Becky says hi and wants to know when you and Sara are finally coming over for dinner. Pick a Saturday and we'll make it happen.
